material_extraction.finish: 63 surface-texture callout with G at the indicated face; see finish field.

finish: Surface-texture symbol marked 63 on the upper face in the front view; associated G indicates grinding. Roughness units and parameter are not explicitly stated; customary interpretation is 63 microinch Ra, requiring confirmation.
general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES. Two PLACE DIM. ± lines and an ANGULAR DIM. ± line are present, but no numerical tolerances or decimal-place qualifiers are readable.

views.description: Upper-left face view: rounded rectangular outline, four mounting holes and two blind counterbored holes. Cutting plane A-A passes through the right blind hole and looks left.
views.centerline_notes: Center marks and intersecting centerlines identify the four mounting-hole centers and two counterbored-hole centers. The blind holes share a horizontal centerline midway between mounting-hole rows. A-A is a section designation, not a datum.

views.description: Lower-left rectangular elevation, showing overall width and thickness, hidden mounting-hole walls and the left blind stepped bore with drill point. A leader gives the two-place blind drilling/counterboring specification.
views.centerline_notes: Vertical centerline at the illustrated left blind bore. Hidden detail is illustrated locally rather than repeated for every hole.

views.description: SECTION A-A, at right: hatched solid section through the right blind counterbored hole. Shows a shallow counterbore, smaller blind drilled bore and conical drill point; no through penetration.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal bore-axis centerline marked CL. Section arrows in the top view establish viewing direction.

dimensions.notes: Printed .50; the leading decimal is faint.
Two places. Drill point is shown; its angle and whether the specified depth includes the point are not explicitly defined.

C'BORE diameter limits printed as 1.012 above 1.002; two places. Value stores lower limit, not a specified nominal. Drawn counterbore size is not proportional to this callout; do not scale the illustration.

dimensions.notes: Exact callout reads X .111/.113 DEEP, 2 PLACES. Interpreted numerical range is .111–.113; value stores the smaller limit. Confirm the reversed limit order before manufacture.

features.description: Base block, 3.25 wide by 2.75 in the top face, extruded 1.5 thick. Corner rounds are a separate final feature.
Seed .40-diameter mounting hole, through all. Absolute edge location is not dimensioned.
Complete the four-hole rectangular mounting pattern: two columns 2.38 apart and two rows 1.88 apart; quantity includes seed.

Left .58-diameter blind drilled bore, .50 deep, with a drill point shown but not angularly dimensioned. Its center is .50 right of the left mounting column and .94 above the lower mounting row, derived from the dimension chains.
Second blind drilled bore 1.38 to the right of the seed, at the same face-height coordinate; quantity includes seed.

Concentric flat-bottom counterbore on left blind bore. Diameter limits 1.002–1.012; depth limits interpreted as .111–.113. Modeling target within these limits must be selected; confirm depth callout ordering.
Repeat counterbore on the right blind drilled bore, 1.38 center spacing; quantity includes seed.
Four rounded outside corners of the top-view rectangular outline, interpreted as thickness-direction edge fillets. Radius is not specified; do not assign a manufacturing radius from image scaling.

symmetry.plane: Vertical plane midway between the mounting-hole columns
symmetry.description: Internal hole layout is left/right symmetric: each blind bore is .50 inward from its adjacent mounting column. Coincidence of this plane with the block center is visually suggested, but not dimensioned.

symmetry.plane: Plane through the blind-bore axes, midway between mounting-hole rows
symmetry.description: The .94 upper-row offset is half the 1.88 row spacing. Coincidence with the block mid-height is not explicitly dimensioned.

concentric_groups.description: Left blind drilled bore and its counterbore share an axis normal to the top face.
Right blind drilled bore and its counterbore share an axis normal to the top face.

equal_spacing.computed_from: Two mounting-hole columns; one horizontal gap, explicitly dimensioned 2.38.
Two mounting-hole rows; one vertical gap, explicitly dimensioned 1.88.
1.88 from left blind axis to right mounting column minus .50 from right blind axis to that column = 1.38.

dimension_chains.description: Left blind axis to right mounting column: 1.38 + .50 = 1.88.

warnings: Drawing explicitly specifies inches and third-angle projection, but names no ASME/ISO/DIN standard. No revision is entered; the C in 116-C is retained as part of the drawing number. Title block also lists MODEL No. 90 B.
No usable numerical general tolerances can be extracted. Zero default tolerance fields on dimensions do not mean zero manufacturing tolerance.

Absolute hole-pattern offsets from the block edges are not dimensioned. Thus edge-referenced instance_positions and position_known are intentionally left unset. Relative to the lower-left mounting-hole center, mounting centers are (0,0), (2.38,0), (0,1.88), (2.38,1.88); blind-bore centers are (.50,.94) and (1.88,.94).

If the mounting pattern is assumed centered on the block, edge margins would be (3.25-2.38)/2 = .435 horizontally and (2.75-1.88)/2 = .435 vertically. This is an unconfirmed assumption, not a dimensioned edge location.
Four outside corner rounds are shown without a radius. A fully constrained manufacturing model cannot be produced without resolving their size and confirming their extent through the thickness.

Counterbore diameter limits read 1.012 over 1.002. The depicted counterbore-to-drill diameter proportions do not match these numbers; retain the printed dimensions rather than scaling the drawing, and verify against the source if necessary.
Counterbore depth limits read .111 over .113, in reversed conventional order. Confirm that .111–.113 is intended before manufacturing.
H002 counterbore diameter and depth store the lower limits, not specified nominal values. Refer to D010 and D011 for the complete permitted ranges.
Blind drill point angle and the precise depth endpoint convention are not explicitly specified; do not silently assume a drill angle.
The 63 finish callout is not a linear dimension. Microinch Ra and grinding are customary interpretations of the shown notation; the roughness unit/parameter is not explicitly written.
No feature control frames, GD&T datum symbols, or reference dimensions are present. Section designation A-A must not be interpreted as datum A.
